properties.name: systemd.status-providers.file-descriptors.health
properties.description: Suppress the watchdog heartbeat while the open file descriptors are at or above the threshold, so that systemd restarts the application.

properties.name: systemd.status-providers.file-descriptors.threshold
properties.description: Share of the limit of file descriptors from which the application is unhealthy, greater than 0 and at most 1, such as 0.9 for 90%. Only applies with health enabled.

properties.name: systemd.status-providers.file-descriptors.unhealthy-delay
properties.description: Delay suppressing the watchdog heartbeat until the open file descriptors have been at or above the threshold for this long, such as 30s, so that a short burst of connections does not restart the application. Values without a unit are in milliseconds. Not set by default, which disables the delay. Only applies with health enabled.

properties.name: systemd.status-providers.cgroup-tasks.health
properties.description: Suppress the watchdog heartbeat while the tasks of the control group are at or above the threshold, so that systemd restarts the application.

properties.name: systemd.status-providers.cgroup-tasks.threshold
properties.description: Share of the limit of tasks from which the application is unhealthy, greater than 0 and at most 1, such as 0.9 for 90%. Only applies with health enabled.

properties.name: systemd.status-providers.cgroup-tasks.unhealthy-delay
properties.description: Delay suppressing the watchdog heartbeat until the tasks have been at or above the threshold for this long, such as 30s, so that a short burst of work does not restart the application. Values without a unit are in milliseconds. Not set by default, which disables the delay. Only applies with health enabled.

properties.name: systemd.status-providers.garbage-collection.health
properties.description: Suppress the watchdog heartbeat while the garbage collection pauses take the threshold of the time or more, so that systemd restarts the application.

properties.name: systemd.status-providers.garbage-collection.threshold
properties.description: Share of the time taken by the garbage collection pauses from which the application is unhealthy, greater than 0 and at most 1, such as 0.5 for 50%. Only applies with health enabled.

properties.name: systemd.status-providers.garbage-collection.unhealthy-delay
properties.description: Delay suppressing the watchdog heartbeat until the garbage collection pauses have taken the threshold of the time or more for this long, such as 60s or 5m, so that a burst of allocations does not restart the application. Values without a unit are in milliseconds. Only applies with health enabled. With a delay of 0, the application is restarted as soon as the pauses take that share of the time.

properties.name: systemd.health-provider.enabled
properties.description: Enable the health provider based on Spring Boot Actuator.

properties.name: systemd.health-provider.unhealthy-status-codes
properties.description: Status codes to consider as unhealthy.

properties.name: systemd.health-provider.unhealthy-pending-period-ms
properties.description: Period, in milliseconds, to wait before reporting the unhealthy state.
